body.name: Selected-subgraph replacement
body.construction: Given \(\eta\in\mathcal C(\mathcal O)\), define \(\operatorname{RepGraph}(\eta,B)=(\widetilde G_0,(\widetilde T_k)_{k=1}^{K})\) as follows. Replace the basal edge set by \(\bigl(E(G_0(\eta))\setminus E(G_0(\eta)[A(\eta)])\bigr)\cup E(B)\), add a childless pair-parent selection node for every edge of \(H[A(\eta)]\), and add a singleton-parent selection node for every vertex of \(A(\eta)\). For each \(k\in[K]\), retain \(T_k(\eta)\setminus A(\eta)\) and let \(\widetilde T_k\cap A(\eta)\) be the ancestry-minimal generators of \(Z_k\cap A(\eta)\) in \(\widetilde G_0\): \(v\in Z_k\cap A(\eta)\) is included exactly when it is not a proper descendant of another vertex of \(Z_k\cap A(\eta)\) or of a retained exterior direct target. This construction specifies only \(\widetilde G_0\) and \(\widetilde T_k\); it assigns no kernels and does not designate a replacement model.
